visual.general_description: Single axial head CT slice at skull-base level in brain/soft-tissue window, showing the orbits, nasal and sphenoid air spaces, temporal fossae and posterior fossa.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale axial CT, slightly tilted, without panel letters, arrows, text, scale or window labels. Both orbits and the globe at image upper right are visible with air-filled ethmoid/sphenoid spaces centrally. Dense white bone of the skull base borders a gray posterior fossa with the cerebellar hemispheres and vermis in the lower center, and gray temporal lobe tissue on each side. At the lower midline the posterior bony outline is interrupted, and the soft tissue behind this gap is irregular with small dark (air-density) foci. On the image right a smoothly marginated gray temporal-fossa region sits next to bone. At the image left the soft tissue lateral to the skull is irregular with small dark (air-density) foci. No annotation marks a collection or fistulous tract, so the described collection cannot be separately confirmed on this slice from pixels alone.
